result.card: This pull request adds an accessor function to expose the transaction version field in the libbitcoinkernel C API and C++ wrapper. Currently, external consumers of libbitcoinkernel must manually slice and inspect serialized bytes to access the transaction version. The PR adds btck_transaction_get_version alongside existing accessors like locktime and input counts, accompanied by unit tests across several transaction versions.
